scenes.headline: You will never feel ready
scenes.narration: Waiting to feel ready is the most polite way to never start.

scenes.headline: A line worth keeping
scenes.narration: Martin Luther King Junior wrote something that applies far beyond its time.

quote.text: Darkness cannot drive out darkness; only light can do that.
quote.attribution: Martin Luther King Jr., Strength to Love (1963)

scenes.headline: Small light beats big plans
scenes.narration: You do not need a perfect plan. You need one small action today that adds a little light.

scenes.headline: Do the first ten minutes
scenes.narration: Close this video and give your project ten honest minutes right now.
